allowed_inputs: support ceiling computed from primary-stream support measurements

calibration_rule.unobservable_threshold: largest candidate threshold whose empirical false-censor rate on truly observable development windows is within budget
calibration_rule.observable_threshold: smallest candidate threshold strictly above the unobservable boundary whose empirical false-observable rate on truly unobservable development windows is within budget
calibration_rule.middle_state: the strict interval between thresholds remains COMPROMISED
calibration_rule.infeasible_budget: fail closed rather than collapse the middle state or move the budget

freeze_requirements_remaining: freeze the two error budgets before calibration
run calibration on development-only support truth
commit the calibrated thresholds, development counts, achieved error rates and source manifest SHA
register the final artifact SHA-256 before held-out scoring
claim_boundary: Calibration method only; historical 0.30/0.70 remain development defaults and no field O threshold or performance is claimed.
